title: Sustainable Enterprise Foundations
tagline: Build a business model that holds up environmentally and financially.
description: A practical grounding in circular business models, resource efficiency and impact measurement. Participants leave with a costed sustainability roadmap for their own enterprise and a reporting framework they can take to lenders and partners.

title: Responsible Leadership Intensive
tagline: Lead teams and boards through the transition to sustainable operations.
description: An executive intensive on governance, stakeholder negotiation and change leadership. Delivered through live case clinics drawn from African firms, with a peer cohort of senior leaders and a personal leadership review at the close.

title: Regenerative Agribusiness
tagline: Turn climate-smart farming practice into a bankable operation.
description: Covers soil health economics, water stewardship, traceable supply chains and access to green finance. Built with agricultural cooperatives and delivered largely in the field alongside working farms.

title: Green Finance & Impact Reporting
tagline: Speak the language lenders and impact investors expect.
description: A finance-focused programme on structuring green finance applications and building impact reports that satisfy lenders, donors and boards alike.
